poster.gammalt: The universe's technology group spans cloud communications company Sinch and consumer electronics maker Logitech; a neighboring sector adds Truecaller — the same digital business logic under another label.
poster.nytt: The universe's technology group spans cloud communications company Sinch and consumer electronics maker Logitech; a neighboring sector adds Truecaller — the same digital business logic under another label. Sinch also shows the band's boundary case: in cloud communications, traffic costs eat the gross margin, well below the software band.
